notes.title: Volatica: The Devil's Trap has been selected on Dreamhack Beyond Indie Showcase!
notes.content:
Dear Witches and Wizards!

We are happy to announce, that [i][b] Volatica: The Devil's Trap[/b][/i] has been selected to be on [i][b]DreamHack Beyond Indie Showcase![/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Event Starts: Oct. 14, 2022 at 12:01 AM EDT
